studentResponse: {"rawAnswer":{"explanationQuestion":"Ecosystems are complex systems where living organisms interact with each other and their environment. I learned that food webs show how energy flows through an ecosystem, with producers at the bottom converting sunlight into energy, and consumers at different trophic levels. Decomposers break down dead organisms, returning nutrients to the soil.","observationQuestion":"During our field trip to the local pond, I observed how the ecosystem was interconnected. I saw algae (producers) being eaten by small fish, which were then eaten by larger fish. I also noticed how changes in water temperature affected the behavior of different species."}}
